Samir: CI on main turned red after the serialization refactor merged in PR #7423. Lots of golden test diffs for prompt outputs (tests/gold/test_prompt_serialization.py). Can someone triage?
Maya: Ack — which test is failing exactly? stacktrace or diff?
Samir: The failing assertion is in test_prompt_roundtrip. Snapshot diffs show whitespace/ordering changes in the serialized prompt JSON (looks like dict key order and float repr). Short diff: ```- \"metadata\": {\n-  \"seed\": 42,\n-  \"temperature\": 0.7\n+ \"metadata\": {\n+  \"temperature\": 0.7,\n+  \"seed\": 42\n }```
Maya: that smells like we switched from OrderedDict->normal dict in the serializer, or python's json.dumps sort_keys flag changed. Was there an intentional ordering change?
Samir: The refactor aimed to remove dependency on OrderedDict; I changed dumps(opts) -> simple json.dumps(obj) to speed up. I probably missed stable formatting. Reproduces locally for me with pytest -k prompt_roundtrip.
CI Bot: Rerun requested by @Samir. Rerun queued (build #3192).
Jorge: If we want a quick triage, bisect the merge range. Try: ```git checkout main && git fetch origin && git bisect start HEAD origin/main~10 && git bisect run pytest tests/gold/test_prompt_serialization.py::test_prompt_roundtrip -q``` Should find the exact commit that introduced ordering variance.
Karla: Also check if the golden diffs are just ordering (ok to update) vs semantic content changes (bad). If it's only key order / float formatting, we should make serializer deterministic (sort_keys=True, consistent float formatting) rather than updating goldens.
Samir: Running bisect now locally, will paste commit once found. If it's just ordering I'll push a tiny patch to the serializer to use json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\",\":\")) and stable float formatting.
Maya: Good plan. If you need CI to run a full suite after the fix, ping and I'll trigger the pipeline with higher concurrency.
Samir: Bisect result: culprit commit 1842249872 \"perf: simplify prompt serializer\" — introduced the switch. Reproduced.
Samir: Quick patch tested locally: add sort_keys=True and format floats to 6 decimal places before dump. Tests passed locally and golden updated with `pytest tests/gold/test_prompt_serialization.py::test_prompt_roundtrip -q --update-snapshots` to confirm diff is only ordering/format.
Jorge: Nice. Can you open a PR with the fix + a short test asserting deterministic ordering (e.g., two dicts with different insertion orders produce same serialized string)? Might avoid future regressions.
Samir: Will do. Creating PR now and assigning to Maya for review. Marking this as release-blocker until the fix is merged.
Karla: Thanks — leaving a note in the release board and adding a quick postmortem entry: cause = serializer deterministicness regression, mitigation = add unit + enforce in CI.
CI Bot: Build #3192 completed: rerun still red for older commit; follow-up builds will reflect the PR once opened.
Samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/7481 — small change and unit test. @Maya please review when you can.
Maya: Reviewing now, will approve after CI green. :thumbsup:
Samir: Thanks everyone for quick triage. If anyone hits related gold diffs, point them to this thread.
